PhotoMode.name: Photo_Mode
PhotoMode.description: Free camera, hidden UI and PNG photos. Press F9 to fly the camera anywhere, hide the game's UI and name tags, and save photos bigger than your screen. Only you need it.

EmoteSync.name: Emote_Sync
EmoteSync.description: Emotes and focus activities start together for your whole group, on the same network tick, with looping animations kept in step. Press F7 to join in. Everyone in the group needs the mod.

TeleportSpots.name: Teleport_Spots
TeleportSpots.description: Save the spot you're standing on and teleport back to it with one click. Press F5 to open the window. Only you need it.

SongPlayer.name: Song_Player
SongPlayer.description: Plays MIDI songs on the instrument you're sitting at. Put .mid files in your Music/On-Together folder. Everyone nearby hears the song, even without the mod.

TraceOverlay.name: Trace_Overlay
TraceOverlay.description: Lays a see-through picture over chalkboards and whiteboards so you can trace it with chalk. Put images in Pictures/On-Together/Trace. Only you see the picture.

FocusAnywhere.name: Focus_Anywhere
FocusAnywhere.description: Focus on any ground or in mid-air, with every activity in the game in the focus menu: water ones on land, seat-spot poses anywhere, and a new Play category. Right-click its icon to hide desks and objects. Only you need it.

DeskSnap.name: Desk_Snap
DeskSnap.description: Sit at your desk near a friend's and yours lines up beside it: same direction, same height, small gap. Rows stay level, even in the air. F3 turns it on or off. Only you need it.

ChatRange.name: Chat_Range
ChatRange.description: Shows who's close enough to see your local chat messages, in a small list above the chat box while its Local tab is open. Only you need it.

NameDesigner.name: Name_Designer
NameDesigner.description: Colour each letter of your player name or a session name, with gradients, rainbows, a live preview and presets. Press F4. Only you need the mod; everyone sees the colours.

OutfitSlots.name: Outfit_Slots
OutfitSlots.description: Six more outfit slots (9 in all) in the outfit screen, and a window (F2) to swap outfits with one click. The game's save keeps only slots 1-3, so removing the mod is safe. Only you need it.

QuickHide.name: Quick_Hide
QuickHide.description: Hides the whole game with one key in split screen and mini mode: the world, characters and UI. Press F10 again to bring it back, even from another app. Only you need it.

NetworkCrashFix.name: Network_Crash_Fix
NetworkCrashFix.description: Stops a crash in the game's networking code, seen on a Mac: reading other players' movement ran a few bytes past the end of the data. Same values, read safely. Nothing to open. Only you need it.

DeskSwarm.name: Desk_Swarm
DeskSwarm.description: Fly your desk like a drone (F11). Start a swarm and friends' desks fly around you in 10 shapes (ring, heart, Ferris wheel...) or land in 5 (row, grid, circle...). Everyone sees it. Only you need it to fly; everyone in a swarm needs it.
